Ministry of Health - Manatū Hauora
@minhealthnz
Mar 20
Happy World Oral Health Day!🦷
NZ Health Survey 2024/25 highlights:
• 76.9% of adults report good–excellent oral health
• 91.6% of children rated good–excellent
• 2 in 3 brush with fluoride
• 43% of adults didn’t visit a dental care worker due to cost
